steps.title: 1. e4
steps.body: 1. e4 is the most common first move. It takes the centre and opens lines for your queen and bishop.

steps.title: An Italian-style setup
steps.body: Knight to f3, knight to c6, and bishop to c4 aims at the weak f7 square. Both sides develop quickly.

steps.title: Your move
steps.body: Black played 1... e5. Develop your knight: move g1 to f3.
steps.hint: Knights come out before bishops, and f3 is a good square for them.
steps.success: Good. The knight now attacks the e5 pawn.
